Zubaanein

Customer ki zubaan mein baat karta hai.

Urdu, Roman Urdu, English, Arabic, Farsi, Spanish, Hindi aur Italian. Customer jis zubaan mein likhe, AI usi mein jawab deta hai — aur baat shop tak hi rakhta hai.

  • Sirf aap ki price list se jawab — qeemat apni taraf se nahi banata
  • Ghair mutaliq sawalon ko tameez se mana karta hai
  • Purane customers aur unke pichle orders yaad rakhta hai

Orders

Receipt aur order number ke saath orders.

Product, tadaad, naam, address aur payment ka tareeqa — chat mein hi le kar confirm karta hai, phir #ALI-0012 jaisi saaf receipt bhejta hai.

  • Booking ke baad customer payment ka tareeqa badal sakta hai (COD se JazzCash waghera)
  • Dispatch se pehle customer order cancel kar sakta hai
  • Online payment ke liye PKR 5,199.72 jaisi thodi alag raqam — taake aap har payment foran pehchan lein; total se zyada kabhi nahi

Payment check

Payment screenshots aap ke liye check karta hai.

AI raqam, transaction ID, tareekh aur receiver parhta hai. Jo tasveer receipt na ho use rad karta hai, aur kuch ghalat lage to aap ko khabardar karta hai:

  • Raqam wajib raqam se kam ho
  • Paisa kisi aur account mein gaya ho
  • Screenshot edit kiya hua lage
  • Wohi screenshot ya transaction ID kisi aur order mein use hui ho

⚠️Koi bhi AI har jaali screenshot nahi pakad sakta. Parcel bhejne se pehle payment hamesha apni bank ya JazzCash app mein confirm karein.

Seller control

Sab kuch WhatsApp se chalayein.

Har naya order aur payment screenshot tap buttons ke saath aata hai: Paid, Not paid, Dispatched, Cancel. Ya chhoti si command likh dein:

paid 21dispatched 18-24cancel 18 out of stockrefunded 18returned 18undo 18pendingsolved C3

✅Har kaam se pehle aik jaldi Yes/No poocha jata hai — phir customer ko khud bata diya jata hai. Koi app nahi chahiye.

Subah ki list

Aaram se soyein. Subah 8 baje list tayyar.

Quiet hours mein raat 11 se subah 8 baje tak phone khamosh rehta hai. Subah aap ko aik list milti hai:

  • Check karne wali payments
  • Bhejne wale parcels
  • Wajib refunds
  • Shikayatein, number ke saath C1, C2…

Yeh bhi shamil hai

Bohat si chhoti cheezein jo bara waqt bachati hain.

Lambi yaaddasht

Purane customers aur unke orders yaad rakhta hai. “Maine aakhri order kab kiya tha?” — jawab tayyar.

Cancel, refund, return

Aik aik line mein: cancel 18, refunded 18, returned 18 — aur iraada badle to undo 18.

COD hifazat

Jis customer ke 2 COD parcel wapas aa jayein, use aage advance payment karni hogi.

Number wali shikayatein

Shikayatein C1, C2… ke number se aap ki team tak jati hain, aur customer ko 24 ghante mein jawab ka waada milta hai.

Reminder aur auto-cancel

Online order ki payment na aaye to 24 ghante baad reminder, aur 72 ghante baad order khud cancel.

Apni currency, apna time zone

Har business ki apni currency aur time zone — Gulf ya Europe mein bechna bhi mumkin hai.

Sawalat

Aap ke sawal, hamare jawab.

Kya naya number chahiye?

Aam taur par haan — aisa number jo pehle se WhatsApp par na ho. Ya apna maujooda number bhejein, hum check kar lenge ke kya woh connect ho sakta hai.

Kya yeh cancel ya refund kar sakta hai?

Haan. Customer dispatch se pehle order cancel kar sakta hai. Aap aik line se cancel, refunded ya returned likh sakte hain (cancel 18, refunded 18, returned 18), aur zaroorat ho to undo bhi. Har kaam se pehle Yes/No poocha jata hai, phir customer ko khud bata diya jata hai.

Kya mera data mehfooz hai?

Har business ka setup alag hota hai — apna number, products, qeematein aur customers. Aap ka data aap ki shop ke assistant ko chalane ke liye use hota hai. Mukammal tafseel ke liye hamari Privacy Policy parhein.

Yeh kaun si zubaanein bolta hai?

Urdu, Roman Urdu, English, Arabic, Farsi, Spanish, Hindi aur Italian. Silver plan mein Urdu, Roman Urdu aur English; Gold aur Premium mein tamam zubaanein.

Agar AI ghalti kare to?

AI sirf aap ke products aur qeematon se jawab deta hai aur shop ki baat tak rehta hai. Har payment aap khud apni bank ya JazzCash app mein confirm karte hain, aur shikayatein C1 jaise number ke saath seedhi aap ki team tak jati hain.

Kya Pakistan se bahar use ho sakta hai?

Ji haan. Har business ki apni currency aur time zone hoti hai. Bahar ke plans USD 29/mahina se shuru hain.
